'''Sanctuary Coast''' was a sprawling [[city]] located on the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]] that was built on enormous stilts on the border of a large inland [[Ocean|sea]]. Throughout the city's history, its leaders were committed to offering assistance to [[refugee]]s fleeing wars and oppression.

==History==
Sanctuary Coast was a growing [[Alderaanian]] [[city]] that was built on massive metal stilts on the edge of a large inland [[Ocean|sea]]. The city was originally founded by individuals fleeing old [[Galactic Republic]] wars, and during the [[Clone Wars]], upheld its traditions by welcoming [[refugee]]s. After the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], many fled to Sanctuary Coast to flee Imperial oppression. Because of this, the Empire maintained a fixed watch on the city, seeking fugitives of its wanted list. Sanctuary Coast's [[Sanctuary Coast Starport|starport]] maintained a steady stream of [[starship]] traffic, which allowed it to conceal occasional transportation of anti-Imperial [[agent]]s and vessels.<ref name="Dawn" />

Sanctuary Coast, along with the rest of [[Alderaan]], was [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroyed]] by the Empire's planet-[[Death|killing]] [[battle station]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]].<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sanctuary Coast was first mentioned in the [[2018]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]] sourcebook ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'',<ref name="Dawn" /> a sourcebook based off of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' and ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Announce">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2017/7/11/dawn-of-rebellion|text=Dawn of Rebellion}}</ref>
